category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: The exact product targets gloss, surface smoothing and manageability rather than a named scalp concern; ordinary balanced scalp route is supported.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 gives effective cleansing, but CAPB, later coco-glucoside and early silk/lipid/polymer care routes keep the net formula below strong. Observed intensity: regular.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: normal — High rinse-off smoothness with only moderate weight is a strong shine/silk fit for normal hair. coarse — Coarse hair can use the high-conditioning shine/smoothing profile, while moderate weight avoids an overly light-only fit. Conditional (not emitted): fine — High conditioning and moderate residue potential can reduce lift on fine hair, even without a silicone stack, so fine fit is conditional rather than ideal.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 gives effective cleansing, but CAPB, later coco-glucoside and early silk/lipid/polymer care routes keep the net formula below strong.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: High: glycosphingolipids, hydrolyzed silk, sericin, Polyquaternium-10 and several refatting/waxy clues create a broad smoothness and slip system.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete canonical formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: Shine is the dominant role: the exact product claims surface smoothing plus shine and suppleness, and the formula has silk/protein, lipid-like and polymer routes compatible with smoothing and gloss.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: No secondary focus is assigned because the claims concentrate on surface smoothing, shine and suppleness; repair is only a neighboring care interpretation, not a distinct exact-product role.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the product is positioned for hair-surface smoothness, shine and manageability, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are standard wet-hair distribution, rinse-out and regular hair-care use, with no daily/frequent, alternating, reset or treatment trigger.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: early lipid-like and silk/protein clues, Polyquaternium-10 and later refatting/waxy materials can leave bounded residue, while SLES/CAPB/glucoside cleansing and no silicone keep it below high.
